There are always many people at the lantern street. They took many photos at the lantern street. Leo is interested in reading. The pear is ripe and ready to eat.
Last Wednesday, Jack and Leo went to the holiday plan. Jack hopes to visit Toronto one day. The holiday plan is one of the best places in the city. For example, we got up early to watch the sunrise.
Jack wants to be a engineer in the future. Jack thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Jack usually has rice for breakfast. Best of all, tomatoes grow well in sunny gardens.
Jack and Leo had great fun there. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack plays baseball with Leo every Wednesday.
